title: Saturn Super Vol. 11 Furoku CD-ROM
native_title: サターン・スーパー Ｖｏｌ．１１ 付録ＣＤ‐ＲＯＭ
overview:
Saturn Super Vol. 11 is a Japanese supplement CD-ROM packaged with issue 11 of Takarajimasha's Saturn Super magazine. Discs in the series carry playable demos and video footage of Saturn games.

This volume includes an original video, Emily no Kyuujitu.
